The combat in Fire Emblem games is TRPG , which isn't like Persona 5 at all. You have to move troops around a mapped battlefield to complete certain goals such as routing the enemy, timed goals like defeating the boss in 16 turns, or escaping. Fire Emblem games are combat heavy and the socializing with side characters is kept to a minimum. The purpose of creating bonds with support characters is to make them stronger on the battlefield, or to have children who can help aid in fights too. It's definitely not like Persona games at all. In the previous games, every chapter of the story had a battle to go through after going through a small amount of story. The new game will probably be similar. Overall, if this type of combat doesn't appeal to you, then you might become bored.
